subject: Data Engineering
title: What Is the Modern Data Stack?
description: One-minute skill: What Is the Modern Data Stack?.

hook.text: Around 2019, a new term appeared: the Modern Data Stack. It described a set of cloud-native tools that worked together.

buildup.text: The stack: a managed ingestion tool, a cloud warehouse, a transformation framework, and a BI layer.

discovery.text: Each tool does one thing well. Fivetran ingests. Snowflake stores. dbt transforms. Looker visualizes.

twist.text: The 'modern' stack is already evolving. New tools challenge each layer, and the stack looks different every year.

climax.text: The real innovation isn't any single tool — it's the composable, best-of-breed architecture that connects them.

punchline.text: Best-of-breed tools, loosely coupled. That's the modern stack.

quiz.question: What defines the Modern Data Stack?
options: Cloud-native, composable tools that each do one thing well
